summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Changes: new cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_secret and client_id; airflow mapping with login/extra.client_id and password/extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var refs for both secrets last). Registered in cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py (import, ordered list directly after the token mapping, __all__). Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-mapping precedence, OAuth selection, profile/env-var output, and profile-arg override protection. Tests were not run and no code was executed, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing committed.
